judgments.reason: Paper reports interrater reliability of sleep scoring (AASM vs R&K) on the SIESTA database; it is a cited background reference, not a description of the BOAS dataset.
judgments.paper_title: Interrater reliability for sleep scoring according to the Rechtschaffen & Kales and the new AASM standard

judgments.reason: The AASM inter-scorer reliability program paper describes a sleep-scoring standard/protocol that the dataset's human sleep scoring relies on, not this dataset itself.
judgments.paper_title: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine Inter-scorer Reliability Program: Sleep Stage Scoring

judgments.reason: Same group (Bitbrain, Sierra-Torralba, Klinzing) studies automatic sleep scoring CNNs using sleep datasets, but it is an algorithm study, not the BOAS data descriptor.
judgments.paper_title: Automatic sleep scoring for real-time monitoring and stimulation in individuals with and without sleep apnea
